Born and raised in Colorado, Crystal earned her BS in Nutrition and Dietetics with a minor in Biomedical Sciences at Colorado State University. She worked in the medical field for several years, cultivating an analytical mindset that is crucial in assessing risks. Since obtaining her Property and Casualty license in 2015, she has gained extensive experience in account management, leadership, and operations management. Building strong relationships is her passion, and she thrives in the ever-evolving insurance industry.  
  
Crystal is dedicated to her family and cherishes time with her son and nephew. During her free time, she enjoys painting, reading, and engaging in a variety of physical activities, including hiking, mountain biking, paddle boarding, yoga, and obstacle course racing.
